posts.title: The power of a line, finding comfort in challenge
posts.description: I find comfort in restraints; maybe it feels better when it’s difficult. I don’t use brushes when I paint, I use knives. Always. I draw only in pen, restricting myself to five, maybe six lines. The fewer the better, and ideally perched on Cornish cliff with a sheer drop beneath my feet.
